name: io.citedin/citedin
title: CitedIn
description: AI search visibility: check AI crawler access, schema and product pages; read CitedIn workspaces.

tools.name: check_ai_crawlers
tools.description: Whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google and other AI crawlers can read a page: robots.txt rules and what the server answers each crawler. No AI, no sign-in.

tools.name: check_schema
tools.description: The JSON-LD on a page (Organization, Product, Article…), what is missing or invalid, and whether the sitemap is found. No AI, no sign-in.

tools.name: check_product_ai_readiness
tools.description: Whether a product page gives AI shopping answers what they need: Product schema, price, availability, GTIN, image, robots. No AI, no sign-in.
